source.label: Near-infrared
source.coverage: USGS ISIS display export: exact zero indicates Null and is masked; valid values starting at one remain, including dark lakes and dunes. A small southern gap receives a gray grid. Grid edges extend by less than half a source pixel beyond the poles/meridian.
source.photometry: Published weighted, high-pass-sharpened ISS mosaic at 938 nm. Haze and cloud residuals, variable native resolution and image boundaries remain. This is a display-stretched infrared observation, not visible color or calibrated albedo.
